title: Are you searching for the right job "titles"? ✍️
description:
You can use ChatGPT to help brainstorm titles if you’re feeling stuck! And always worth searching for other levels within the same job family (e.g., lead, manager, senior manager). Sometimes a job title at one company means something else at another in terms of years of experience! #jobsearchtips #linkedinprofiletips #chatgpt
